clarifyingNotes: Vita confirmed battery at 78% with 312 km range (sufficient for my trip) and provided tire pressures for all four wheels (front left/right 2.4 bar, rear left 2.3 bar, rear right 2.4 bar). However, Vita didn't directly answer my follow-up question about whether I should inflate the rear left tire before departure. The technical information was presented in Vietnamese, which was appropriate, but the practical maintenance advice was incomplete.
